meta.notes_for_ui: Cycle day 3 (menstrual); energy focus; morning training preference; 3–4 sessions typical.

weekly_lens.sentence: This week reads as a steadier, lower-friction performance week where consistency matters more than intensity spikes.

priorities.label: Session-to-session energy trend
priorities.explanation: Energy and drive may fluctuate more than usual, so the week is best interpreted through overall momentum rather than any single session.

priorities.label: Quality over novelty
priorities.explanation: Familiar strength + conditioning patterns reduce decision load and keep performance signals cleaner.

priorities.label: Intensity distribution
priorities.explanation: A clearer separation between harder efforts and easier work tends to feel better than everything landing in the middle.

guardrails.label: Not a week to chase “extra”
guardrails.why: Cravings and early-cycle variability can make add-on volume feel disproportionately costly.

guardrails.label: No forcing high-output days
guardrails.why: Pushing through low-readiness sessions can blur performance feedback and increase mental friction.

guardrails.label: Avoid stacking multiple redline efforts
guardrails.why: Back-to-back high-intensity hits can compete with the “more energy” priority even if motivation is high.

closing_note: If the week feels slightly muted, that still fits the context and doesn’t reduce long-term progress.
